summary: provider "custom" always reports success:false Unknown provider in testConnectionHelper even though validators allow it and the apiKey check exempts it (no custom probe branch exists).
impact: Custom model modules can never pass a connection test; settings UI shows a misleading Unknown provider error.
fix_sketch: Add a custom branch (minimal probe against endpointUrl) or return an explicit unsupported-probe verdict distinct from unknown provider.

summary: module-service.ts:166-168 comment says a full fix needs DB onDelete:cascade / FK constraint out of scope, but schema.ts:224-228 ALREADY has FKs (instruction: NOT NULL + cascade; others: set null). The guard is the only thing preventing instruction-module delete from cascade-deleting agent rows.
impact: Stale comment; if the 409 guard races (check-then-delete TOCTOU at module-service.ts:147-155 vs :565) or is bypassed, deleting an instruction module silently deletes referencing agents via cascade.
fix_sketch: Update the comment to reflect real FK state; add a DB-level regression note; optionally move the guard into a transaction. Docs sync required.

summary: Unscoped moduleGate.model.list() in cost dashboard: PG/dual tier lists all workspaces' model rows; local tier reads only the default folder (wrong/empty rows for a scoped workspace).
impact: Dashboard model metadata can be cross-tenant or empty depending on tier.
fix_sketch: Thread workspaceId from the request into the call, or document the meta lookup as intentionally global.

summary: librarian-runtime calls moduleGate.model.get(routedModuleId) unscoped; local-tier workspaces with scoped module rows get null (silent degrade), PG tier resolves by id across workspaces.
impact: Librarian summarization silently degrades in local tier; low cross-tenant by-id risk (UUID ids).
fix_sketch: Pass the librarian agent's workspaceId into the get call.

summary: Blocker search under-reports: agentRegistry.list is capped at 200 rows (default limit) and excludes archived agents (isNull archivedAt); module-service passes no limit.
impact: With >200 referencing agents the 409 names only the first page; PG delete may then proceed and FK set-null/cascade fires.
fix_sketch: Raise/parameterize the roster limit for guard lookups or paginate the blocker scan.

summary: testModelModule decrypt-failure fallback probes the provider with the stored ciphertext as the API key.
impact: Sends ciphertext to a third party and guarantees a confusing auth failure instead of a clear local error.
fix_sketch: Return a failure verdict stating the stored key is undecryptable instead of probing with ciphertext.

summary: Test name says module create without a workspace scope throws in production-like envs but the assertion documents the VITEST exemption (resolves undefined); the production scope guard is never asserted.
impact: False confidence: prod scope-refusal behavior untested; a regression allowing unscoped prod writes would pass the suite.
fix_sketch: Split into a VITEST-exemption test and a non-VITEST guard test (mock env.VITEST).

summary: Local store scope guard is bypassed whenever process.env.VITEST is set (any value).
impact: A process with VITEST set would allow unscoped writes into the default folder.
fix_sketch: Narrow the exemption to a test-only flag (setLocalStoreDirForTests non-null) instead of env sniffing.
